read_from: classes.dex (Dalvik) via android_method_show; JADX 1.5.6 used only for readability

target.note: The APK has no readable ELF/PE/Mach-O program. Its assets/* files start with the encrypted PairIP 'IAP' header; the native reader rejects both the APK and its DEX. Addresses below are DEX code-unit offsets.

values.name: play/pause fade range and step
values.source: both SeekBarPreferenceCompat rows in default_preference.xml: msbp_interval=250, msbp_maxValue=4000, msbp_minValue=0, msbp_measurementUnit=ms

values.name: fade-in curve
values.value: level = ((i*100/steps)/10)^2, steps=duration/100, one step every 100 ms, first sleep 300 ms only for odd durations
values.source: ub.run 0x0000-0x0063; level 0,1,4,9..100 applied with q60.b0 only when it exceeds q60.E; final b0(100)

values.name: fade-out curve
values.value: level = start - ((start*i/steps)/10)^2, steps=duration/100; type 2 jumps to i=steps/3+1 after the first 100 ms
values.source: vb.run 0x0000-0x0075; start captured with q60.E, only lowers the level, ends with b0(0) and pause; MusicService.W calls M(...,2,...)

values.name: fade volume scale
values.source: q60.E = round(ExoPlayer volume * 100); q60.b0(v) writes v/100.0f
